text: One slicer per page, chosen for what that page is actually for — not five slicers nobody will touch.
Each page's slicer matches its purpose directly: year for regional comparison, category for profitability, region for fulfillment.
A hidden fourth page holds the detail. Right-clicking any territory on Page 1 jumps straight there, pre-filtered — summary stays clean, detail is one click away.
Check every page: selecting a bar should filter the rest of the page. If something doesn't respond, that's Edit interactions — confirm it's intentional, not an accident.
Interactivity added where it earns its place, nowhere else. Lesson 91 finally publishes this to the Power BI service.
